column1: # Expected outcome per arm and window for src/test_gap_windows.cpp.
# spans is an EQUALITY per window: a new join needs molecule coverage and
# truth-orientation review before its expectation changes. TOTAL rows hold
# counts of spanned windows. min_in_gap_hets is a floor on SITES
# There is deliberately no read-count column. How many reads end up tagged
# follows from decisions the solver may make differently, so a floor on it
# fails on improvements and pinning it invites a refresh that launders a
# regression. The assertions that do not live in this file and cannot drift:
# no clean het inside a gap is left without a phase set, no block switches
# across a gap. min_concordance is a per-arm read-concordance floor -- a rate,
# not a count -- rounded DOWN, per arm because the arms are not equally
# mature: graph-first pays a read-placement cost and recording its measured
# floor states that in the baseline rather than hiding it behind a loose
# global bound or letting it block the suite.
# min_separated is the headline: the fraction of the window's truth-scorable
# reads that ONE block places correctly. Purity alone hides fragmentation --
# two immaculate half-blocks separate nobody -- and block count alone hides
# switches. Rounded DOWN, like the concordance floor.
